detail.longDescription: There have been several questions (e.g. this ) on SO regarding loading multiple copies of a shared library in C, but I'm trying to figure out how to do it in Rust. Similar to the background in the question linked above, I need to use a third-party C library to connect to some remote service, which I created Rust bindings (using bindgen) for. The C lib can only connect to one instance of such service because it stores the singleton client in a static variable. I need to connect to ~30 instances, thus I'm looking for a way to isolate one copy of the lib from another. How (in Linux)?
